notes: No article morpheme stands anywhere in כָּל־מַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ or in אִמְרֵי־פִיךָ, so nothing is fronted under rule 29: each written 'the' is supplied and joins the noun it stands before — 'the kings' to the construct and 'the earth' to the rectum, which is rule 29's second-'the' allowance for a multi-level chain.
The vocative's 'O' stays with the name under rule 36 and is not the verb's; the verb's own subject is the explicit כָּל־מַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ, so no subject pronoun belongs to s001.
s001 heads on 'thanks' under rule 44's light-verb clause, discontinuous around the object pronoun under rule 25.
